title: Page 129
transc:
may sweden watkins this morning stop we hear nothing directly
from Meriden stop warmer summer say Noses prospect was at
chapel yesterday stop Midas whiffs from Carthage that when Meriden
left he said he intended to strike the racines ravish
but where or how he does not state tulip message
after message rank but no reply has been recd stop
All your instructions have been planted to Shark Watkins &
he will do his best to carry them out pike
but Savory late hour in which saints fit to take
the opinion have reached here he will hardly be able
to do the raven much injury stop He is directed
to torch him white till further instructions are recd from
you tulip While writing the above yours of Nancy is
received tulip I will whimper to Bunyan to send no
more talbot Morgan pelham than the fragments of Emorys queen
still behind stop The story about an extended raid on
Trinity Look Out is without foundation spike no robin passed
Bladensburg stop Warsaw plantation to Grammar trifle retrembled wedlock stick 
Baron & Biscay Walpole is watsoned nearly repaired from world
to Churn Welch Battle will send you maps thro Leet
